task.title: Microneedle and microarray-patch vaccine trials: registered versus published primary outcomes
task.criteria: Submit one JSON artifact of at most 16 KiB with fields observedAt (ISO 8601 UTC), query, rows and summary. The submission passes only if every check holds. (1) query is exactly this ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 URL: https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies?query.intr=microneedle+OR+microarray+patch&query.term=vaccine&pageSize=100 (2) rows hold one row per NCT ID that the query returns for a study whose studyFirstPostDate is on or before observedAt, and no other IDs. (3) each row copies registeredPrimaryOutcomes verbatim from protocolSection.outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes[].measure and timeFrame, and overallStatus and hasResults exactly as the record reports them. (4) each row lists publications: every PubMed ID in the record referencesModule with type RESULT, plus every PubMed ID that an esearch of PubMed for the NCT ID returns; each listed PubMed record must contain the NCT ID. (5) a row with at least one publication gives publishedPrimaryOutcome, a verbatim quote of at most 300 characters from that PubMed abstract, and verdict match, changed, added, omitted or unclear; match requires the same measure and the same time frame as one registered primary outcome. A row without a publication has verdict no_publication. (6) summary counts each verdict and the counts equal the rows. A verifier reruns the query, reads every listed registry record and resolves every listed PubMed ID; one missing or extra NCT ID, one unresolvable ID, one registry field that is not copied verbatim, or one count mismatch fails the whole submission (0/1).
task.eligibility_basis: Reviews describe microneedle vaccine immunogenicity and manufacturing, but none compares what these trials registered as primary outcomes with what they published.

rationale.effort: About 40 minutes for an AI system: one registry query, reading each returned record and linking each trial to its PubMed publications.
rationale.difficulty: Low to moderate: careful verbatim extraction and one rule-bound classification per row; no lab work, no new model training.
rationale.novelty: No open dataset or published audit answers this exact question for this intervention class; the drafting searches are recorded with the task.
rationale.verificationCost: Low: a verifier reruns one fixed API query and resolves each NCT and PubMed ID; every classification carries a verbatim quote.

task.title: Completed communication brain-computer interface trials: census of registered primary endpoints
task.criteria: Submit one JSON artifact of at most 16 KiB with fields observedAt (ISO 8601 UTC), query, rows and summary. The submission passes only if every check holds. (1) query is exactly this ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 URL: https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies?query.intr=brain-computer+interface+OR+intracortical&query.term=speech+OR+communication&filter.overallStatus=COMPLETED&pageSize=100 (2) rows hold one row per NCT ID that the query returns for a study whose studyFirstPostDate is on or before observedAt, and no other IDs. (3) each row copies protocolSection.outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes[].measure verbatim, and overallStatus and phases exactly as the record reports them. (4) each row gives category, exactly one of communication_rate, decoding_accuracy, safety_device, usability_satisfaction, mixed, not_stated, with evidence: a verbatim quote of at most 300 characters from the record that supports the category (not_stated needs no quote). (5) summary counts each category and the counts equal the rows. A verifier reruns the query, reads every listed registry record and checks each quote appears verbatim in that record; one missing or extra NCT ID, one quote not in its record, one field that is not copied verbatim, or one count mismatch fails the whole submission (0/1).
task.eligibility_basis: Reviews of communication BCIs summarise published systems, but no census records what completed registered trials chose as their primary endpoint.

rationale.effort: About 40 minutes for an AI system: one registry query, reading each returned record and classifying one registry field per trial.
rationale.difficulty: Low to moderate: careful verbatim extraction and one rule-bound classification per row; no lab work, no new model training.
rationale.novelty: No open dataset or published review answers this exact registry question; the drafting searches are recorded with the task.
rationale.verificationCost: Low: a verifier reruns one fixed API query and checks each quote against its registry record.

drafts.evidenceFormat: JSON {observedAt, query, rows:[{nct, registered, overallStatus, phases, category, evidence}], summary:{communication_rate,decoding_accuracy,safety_device,usability_satisfaction,mixed,not_stated}} at most 16 KiB
